name: np_drift_squeal
character: Tyres losing grip on a wet road: a stick-slip tone near 1 kHz with its harmonics and a scrub of noise, rising and falling with the slip, diving in the slow motion and cutting off when the tyres bite.
note: The tone is a pulse train at 1.1 kHz (the squeal band the research found, 500-1500 Hz with energy to several kHz) through a tyre-cavity resonance; wet grip is about 20 % below dry, so the level is below a dry squeal. ESTIMATE: the tone, its harmonics and the cavity formants are starting values; wet friction 20 % under dry is from the research note
